newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed names new aeronautical unit head.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed names new aeronautical unit head.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Thursday it named William Bullock the new president of Lockheed Martin Aeronautical Systems in Marietta, Ga., effective immediately.
This unit makes the F-22 air dominance fighter, the C-130J airlifter and Airborne Early Warning & Control aircraft.
Bullock succeeded John McLellan, who was retiring. He had been executive vice president of Lockheed Martin Tactical Aircraft Systems in Fort Worth, Texas since October 1995.

The company said it would name a successor to Bullock later. It said Bullock had strong experience with the C-130, having been deputy program manager, director and vice president of the Hercules program.
